title: Prime Minister shares an article by former Rural Development Secretary Shri Shailesh Kumar Singh highlighting how the Lakhpati Didi initiative is empowering rural women
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by former Rural Development Secretary, Shri Shailesh Kumar Singh. The article outlines how the Lakhpati Didi initiative is helping rural women transition from self-help groups to successful entrepreneurs, achieving sustainable incomes and greater economic independence. It highlights how skills, access to finance, markets and community institutions are enabling women to build enterprises, make economic decisions and shape their own futures. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “From self-help groups to successful entrepreneurs, rural women are shaping a new story of empowerment! Former Rural Development Secretary Shri Shailesh Kumar Singh writes about how the Lakhpati Didi initiative is helping rural women move towards sustainable incomes and greater economic independence.
